newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, few Tudjman nerves.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, few Tudjman nerves.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed in lower turnover on Tuesday but the market showed few nerves over uncertainty about President Tudjman's illness.
"There have been no shakeups so far and I don't expect them to come in the following days either," said Marijan Palic of brokerage Auctor.
Tudjman was admitted to a U.S. hospital last week with some reports he might have cancer, but his doctor said the president felt fine and he was being treated for a stomach ulcer.
* Four of 10 traded issues fell, three rose and three remained unchanged.
* Volume 15,914 shares, turnover 15.5 milion kuna. Full results available on page ZAGSTOCK.
* Top gainer, private Croatia Banka, rose 15 kuna or 11.1 percent to 150 kuna on volume of 95 shares.
* Biggest decliner was hotelier Laguna, dipping 2.54 percent to 1,150 kuna but it only sold 40 shares.
* Most active Zagrebacka Banka with 10,588 ordinary shares sold, edged up six kuna to 1,006. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
